page_title: NMEs Approved in CY 1998 (CDER 'New Drug Approval Reports', fda.gov/cder/rdmt/nmecy98.htm; Wayback capture 2005-10-16) cross-checked line-by-line against CDER Novel Drug Approvals Compilation (media/177921, approval-year 1998 section) and openFDA Drugs@FDA
columns: NDA Number | Established Name | Trade Name | Applicant | Chemical Type / Review Classification | Approval Date (no indication column on the CY1998 table)
classification_legend: 1 = New Molecular Entity; P = Priority Review; S = Standard Review; V = Orphan Drug designation (per the archived CDER legend); footnote: tentative approvals are counted in the year of the tentative approval
row_count_note: DISCREPANCY DOCUMENTED 2026-09-17: the archived CDER CY1998 NME table lists 30 NDA rows (CDER NMEs only; therapeutic biologics were CBER-licensed in 1998). FDA's current official Novel Drug Approvals Compilation (media/177921) lists 36 approval-year-1998 rows: the 30 common rows match the CDER table date-for-date, PLUS Simulect (BLA103764, 5/12), Synagis (BLA103770, 6/19), Infasurf (N020521, 7/1 — tentative approval 5/7/1997 per CDER footnote), Remicade (BLA103772, 8/24), Herceptin (BLA103792, 9/25) and Enbrel (BLA103795, 11/2). All 36 included here, following the 1999 precedent (Compilation = FDA's current official enumeration; the 6 extras carry row_count_flag). 29 of the 30 CDER rows re-verified against openFDA Drugs@FDA (brand + exact ORIG approval date); Refludan (NDA020807) is no longer indexed by openFDA/Drugs@FDA and is flagged. Applicant strings are the CDER table's (e.g. 'Dupont', 'Isis', 'Searle', 'Quintiles' for Arava) kept verbatim; the Compilation applicant is recorded in each row's 'compilation' field.
